data.action: 坐在木质栈桥边缘双腿悬空，推起墨镜凝望碧蓝大海，微风拂动狼尾
data.description: 【德克萨斯 · 汐斯塔海港的微风小憩】汐斯塔碧蓝辽阔的海港栈桥边，海鸥在晴空下盘旋。德克萨斯穿着性感的黑色连体泳衣，外面随意披着一件轻薄白衬衫，坐在木质码头边任由双脚悬在水面上。海风拂动着她的长发与蓬松狼尾，她推起脸上的墨镜，惬意地享受着难得的假期——「汐斯塔的海风……确实比龙门和叙拉古要清爽很多。」
data.lighting: 热带明媚阳光与波光粼粼的湛蓝海面
data.location: 汐斯塔海滨度假木质栈桥码头
data.promptProse: Sitting relaxed on the sun-bleached wooden planks of a harbor pier in Siesta, Texas gazes out over the sparkling turquoise sea under a brilliant clear sky. She wears a sleek black one-piece swimsuit beneath an unbuttoned white linen beach shirt, with her dark wolf tail resting gently beside her dangling legs. Pushing dark sunglasses up onto her head, her calm golden-amber eyes reflect the glistening ocean waves and soaring seagulls. A stunning cowboy shot captures the vibrant tropical atmosphere, clean line work, and her cool yet graceful summer presence in immaculate anime visual novel style.
